ruling: docs/TIER-4-DECISION-SHEET-2026-08-02.md calls 1, 2, 3b, 3d, 5 (Captain-ratified 2026-08-02). Calls 3a/3c/4 held pending new-name ratification; call 6 is a generator change and rides its own pass.

moves.why: call 1 / E1 -- Dwarven Landslide's 'Kicker-{2}{R}, Sacrifice a land' is an ADDITIONAL cost (CR 601.2b), not an alternative one. The axis claims 'instead of paying its normal mana cost'
call 1 / E2 -- Gravity Negator grants FLYING, not a pump. Grammar section 4 separates the verbs; batch-4 D4 is a standing rule that every grants-temporary-<keyword> folds here on sight
call 1 / E7 -- Brokers Charm is a modal instant, not an ETB. Completes its section 1 modal decomposition; it already holds modal / burst-draw / combat-trick-pump-own-creature for the other two modes
call 1 / E9 -- Opal-Eye's '{1}{W}: Prevent the next 1 damage' is an ACTIVATED, fixed-amount prevention. The destination was broadened by batch-5 D2/Q1 to cover exactly the activated-ability delivery
call 1 / E9 -- Inviolability is an Aura preventing all damage to the ENCHANTED creature, another permanent, not to itself

drops.why: call 2 / E3 -- Familiar Beeble Mascot untaps 'target permanent', not the attacker, which is the axis's whole claim. No axis holds attack-trigger-untaps-any-permanent; ledger-flagged homeless per b6 D5's third option
call 2 / E4 -- Arius, Flyby Trawler DISCARDS, never destroys (confirms the open C3 drift finding). No delayed self-discard axis exists; ledger-flagged
call 2 / E11 -- Research // Development shuffles the cards into the LIBRARY; the slug names the hand as the destination. Ledger-flagged as a tutor-from-outside-game-to-library sibling

call 2 / E9 -- Solitary Confinement prevents all damage dealt to YOU, the player, not to the permanent. No player-damage-prevention axis exists; ledger-flagged. It retains its correct rule:skips-controller-draw-step membership

rule:etb-destroy-target-enchantment.48bda7dd-d023-41e8-8c28-e0cfda0d07ca: When this creature enters, destroy target enchantment.

rule:token-count-scales-with-x.35807c14-4647-482f-9ba1-6d640fd5e8d8: Create X 2/2 red Human Knight creature tokens with trample and haste.

definition_edits.rule:prevents-damage-to-self: A static ability of the permanent prevents damage that would be dealt to that same permanent, making it hard to remove with damage. The prevention may be gated by a duration or a turn condition ('During your turn, prevent all damage that would be dealt to ~'). Excludes: activated fixed-amount prevention (rule:prevent-fixed-damage-any-target), Auras protecting the creature they enchant (rule:prevent-damage-to-your-creatures), and effects protecting the PLAYER rather than the permanent.
definition_edits.rule:draw-second-card-trigger-plus1-coun: An ability triggers specifically when the controller draws their SECOND card in a turn, putting a +1/+1 counter on the source. Corrects a definition left stale by batch-5 D12, which renamed this axis from -token to -plus1-counter for its member Lat-Nam Adept but never updated the text; the stale 'creature token' wording was the standing C1a drift finding.
